env.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
env.description: Client ID of a Google OAuth "Web application" client. Its authorized redirect URI must be this app's address followed by /auth/google/callback.

env.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET
env.description: Client secret of that Google OAuth client.

env.name: ADMIN_EMAILS
env.description: Comma-separated Google email addresses that are admins (they set the day letter and breaks, remove people, and manage backups).

env.name: ALLOWED_DOMAINS
env.description: Optional. Comma-separated Google Workspace domains allowed to sign in, for example your school's domain. Leave empty to let any Google account sign in.

env.name: MENU_DISTRICT
env.description: Optional. My School Menus district number for the lunch menu (in the menu page's address). Default: 2534, Mukwonago Area School District.

env.name: MENU_ID
env.description: Optional. My School Menus menu number for the lunch menu. Default: 133305, Mukwonago High School Lunch Menu. Set to off to hide the menu.

env.name: MENU_SITE
env.description: Optional. The site number in the menu page's address (menus.healthepro.com/organizations/2534/sites/15466/menus/133305), used for the 'full menu' link. Default: 15466, Mukwonago High School.

env.name: GOOGLE_TASKS
env.description: Optional. 'on' turns on Assignments from each student's Google Tasks (the Google Cloud project needs the Google Tasks API enabled). Off by default: the Assignments page says 'Coming soon'.

env.name: EVENT_POSTING
env.description: Who can add events to the shared events board: verified (admins and people an admin verifies on the Admin page), everyone, or admins.
